name: @spatial-api/core
description: Core capability-based spatial data provider contract, shared types, filter tree, errors, and validation
author: Spatial API Team

scripts.build: tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && esbuild src/index.ts src/conformance/index.ts src/internal/index.ts --bundle --minify --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.js && esbuild src/index.ts src/conformance/index.ts src/internal/index.ts --bundle --minify --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.cjs && node -e "['dist/index', 'dist/conformance/index', 'dist/internal/index'].forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(f + '.d.ts', f + '.d.cts'))"
